tools.name: jidec_cite
tools.description: Resolve and INDEPENDENTLY verify any JIDEC citation. Accepts 'jidec:path:<sha>', 'jidec:entry:<n>', a bare 64-hex id, or a ledger URL. tools.name: jidec_replay
tools.description: Re-observe an anchored JIDEC verification path against the live system right now and report drift. Returns MATCH (the live system still matches what was anchored) or DRIFT (it changed), node by node. Nodes that cannot be re-observed server-side are reported as deferred, never counted as drift.

tools.name: jidec_list_paths
tools.description: List the anchored JIDEC verification paths (most recent first), with purpose, verdict and Bitcoin anchoring status.

tools.name: jidec_how_to_verify
tools.description: Return the step-by-step recipe for verifying a JIDEC record WITHOUT trusting HORIZON SHIELD: which bytes to fetch, which hashes to recompute, which OpenTimestamps proof to check, which algorithm commit to check out, and what must match. tools.name: nenrin_resume
tools.description: Return the NENRIN résumé of an agent or MCP endpoint: every recorded measurement that touches its origin (by the gate and by outside witnesses, signed or not), which are Bitcoin-anchored, discrepancies, rings, agreements[] (anchored agreements), admissions[] (the anchored admissions whose relying pa

tools.name: nenrin_trust_signal
tools.description: Return the compact NENRIN signal for an endpoint: counts of anchored measurements, witness diversity and freshness, in a shape a trust engine or orderer can read. No score, no allow or deny.

tools.name: nenrin_witness
tools.description: Return one NENRIN witness record by its record SHA-256: pending or anchored, and when anchored, the ledger entry and batch that carry it. Use it to check a walk someone says they submitted.

tools.name: nenrin_ledger_head
tools.description: Return the current head of the JIDEC/NENRIN ledger: entry count n, the head hash, and the end marker bound into the chain (jidec-head-v1) with the recipe to recompute it. Compare it with a head you saw earlier to detect truncation or rewrite.

tools.name: nenrin_ledger_entry
tools.description: Return ledger entry n as the ledger serves it: claim_sha256, the canonical record bytes, work description, OpenTimestamps status and Bitcoin block when anchored. Pair with jidec_how_to_verify to recompute it.

tools.name: nenrin_admission
tools.description: Return one admission record (a2a-admission-v0) as the ledger stores it, by its canonical SHA-256: the exact record bytes, pending or anchored, and the ledger entry once anchored. tools.name: nenrin_agreement
tools.description: Return one agreement record as the ledger stores it, by its canonical SHA-256: the exact record bytes, pending or anchored, and the ledger entry once anchored. The anchored agreements of an endpoint are listed in agreements[] of its Résumé (nenrin_resume).
